topic: Data calibration and migration for specific facility
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on data adjustments for a specific company (7880) and facility (4349). Decisions included changing the calibration to 70 and migrating product data from model1 to production for this facility. Initial discrepancies were noted when comparing dashboard data between prod and model1 environments, particularly regarding aggregation levels.

It was confirmed that the changes made involved re-aggregating the entire company's data (7880) rather than just one mall sensor. The final review clarified that while overall sums might differ due to grouping methods (e.g., a master facility vs. an individual shop), the specific facility's data remained consistent across environments after the migration.

The user was provided with an email address ([email@jcdecaux.com]) for follow-up.
